parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Plan a study using a postal questionnaire to investigate attribution styles in adults with depression.

Your plan must include details about:
• type(s) of data
• sampling technique.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.lead: For one piece of psychological knowledge on which your plan is based:

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Explain how you used two features of this psychological knowledge to plan your study.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Explain one reason for your choice of type(s) of data.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Explain one weakness of the use of a postal questionnaire in your study.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text: Explain one reason for your choice of sampling technique.
